en_title: BioWare's Former Dragon Age Boss Says a Mass Effect-Style Remaster Trilogy Is Pretty Much Impossible
cn_title: 前负责人称《龙腾世纪》重制几乎无望
subtitle: 引擎没人懂了
opus_summary: BioWare前《龙腾世纪》负责人Darrah称，前三作引擎知识已流失，外包无从谈起，《质量效应》式重制三部曲几乎不可能。EA若专组开发，便无法处理其他新项目。

paragraphs.en: Don't hold your breath for remasters of the original Dragon Age trilogy - they're pretty much impossible, BioWare's former Dragon Age boss has said.
paragraphs.cn: 别指望原版《龙腾世纪》三部曲的重制版了——BioWare前《龙腾世纪》负责人称，这事几乎不可能。

paragraphs.en: In an interview with FRVR , ex-Dragon Age series producer Mark Darrah was asked about the chances of a remastered collection of the first three Dragon Age games, similar to the Mass Effect collection. He noted that while he had previously envisioned a "Champion's Trilogy" that would attempt to unify all three games (since they're quite different from each other), he doesn't think it's likely anymore.
paragraphs.cn: 在接受FRVR采访时，前《龙腾世纪》系列制作人Mark Darrah被问及：能否像《质量效应》合集那样，把前三款《龙腾世纪》游戏做成重制合集。他指出，自己过去曾设想过一个名为「Champion's Trilogy」的构想，试图统一三部作品（因为它们彼此差异颇大），但如今他认为这不大可能实现。

paragraphs.en: Why? Because no one currently at BioWare understands the engine those games were built on, and as a result, it also can't be outsourced because all that institutional knowledge is gone.
paragraphs.cn: 为什么？因为目前BioWare已经没人懂得这些游戏使用的引擎；因此也无法外包，因为组织内部积累的相关技术知识已经流失殆尽。

paragraphs.en: “There is basically no one at BioWare anymore that understands the Aurora Engine,” Darrah claimed. “There’s basically no one outside of BioWare anymore that understands the Aurora engine. So unlike Mass Effect, which is Unreal… there are basically no companies that could help you.”
paragraphs.cn: Darrah声称：「如今BioWare基本已经没有人懂Aurora Engine了。BioWare之外也基本没有人懂Aurora Engine。因此它不像使用Unreal引擎的《质量效应》……基本没有公司能帮上忙。」

paragraphs.en: Dragon Age began life in 2009 with the much-loved Dragon Age: Origins , and was quickly followed-up by Dragon Age 2 just two years later. The hugely successful Dragon Age: Inquisition came out in 2014.
paragraphs.cn: 《龙腾世纪》于2009年以备受喜爱的《龙腾世纪：起源》起步，两年后很快推出《龙腾世纪2》；大获成功的《龙腾世纪：审判》则在2014年发售。

paragraphs.en: Darrah noted that the only way a Dragon Age Trilogy remaster might be feasible is if EA built an entire team with this project in mind, but that would ultimately mean they aren't working on other new projects, which isn't as savory for a big publisher like EA.
paragraphs.cn: Darrah指出，若EA为此项目专门组建完整团队，《龙腾世纪》三部曲的重制或许才可行；但这最终意味着他们无法开发其他新项目，对于EA这样的大型发行商而言吸引力没那么大。

paragraphs.en: Darrah had previously noted that EA isn't a big fan of remasters either , which is mostly evident in its library of titles. The Mass Effect trilogy and the remake of Dead Space are exceptions, but fans have been clamoring for revivals of other games like Dragon Age, Need for Speed, and more.
paragraphs.cn: Darrah此前也曾指出，EA不太喜欢重制，这主要从其作品库中也看得出来。《质量效应》三部曲和《死亡空间》重制版是例外，但玩家一直呼吁让《龙腾世纪》《极品飞车》等其他游戏复活。

paragraphs.en: Maybe one day a Dragon Age collection will come to fruition, but it doesn't sound like it would happen anytime soon. It doesn't help that Dragon Age: The Veilguard flopped as well, which may have for the foreseeable future.
paragraphs.cn: 或许有一天《龙腾世纪》合集会成真，但听起来短期内不会发生。《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》也遭遇失败，这在可预见的未来或许也会造成影响。
